title: 🔆🔅Iran’s Foreign Minister Araghchi meets with Turkmen Foreign Minister
text:
🔆🔅Iran’s Foreign Minister Araghchi meets with Turkmen Foreign Minister"

"🔹 Iran’s Foreign Minister Seyyed Abbas Araghchi met on Monday morning, November 2, with Rashid Meredov, Deputy Chairman of the Cabinet of Ministers and Minister of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan. They discussed ways to expand bilateral, regional, and international relations."

"🔹 During the meeting, the two sides reviewed the latest status of relations between Tehran and Ashgabat and emphasized the need to use existing capacities to develop cooperation in various political and economic areas."

"🔹 The Iranian foreign minister traveled to Ashgabat, the capital of Turkmenistan, on a one-day trip for meetings and consultations with Turkmen officials.
